info.title: tclipper
info.description: The tclipper command: batch removal of intros and trailers from video and audio files through ffmpeg. 'tclipper --install-ffmpeg' installs ffmpeg with winget, Homebrew, apt or dnf.

options.name: -intro
options.description:
Can be used with or without the trailer trimming functionality
-cf, -consoleoff - Turns off logging output to console
